body.summary: Urgent: risk of an ER visit or hospital admission in the next 7 days is 6% (urgent line 6%, typical day 1.2%). Risk of a rough patch in the next 7 days: 16% (alert line 13%). The treatment calendar alone gives 10%; wearable signals move it +6 points. Biggest wearable driver: Steps 38% below their usual (7,721 vs 12,395 a day, last 3 days).

profile.context: Day 5 of cycle 4 (IV chemo every 21 days)

evidence.label: Steps
evidence.text: Steps 38% below their usual (7,721 vs 12,395 a day, last 3 days)

evidence.label: Sleep
evidence.text: Sleep efficiency 87% vs usual 92%, waking 3.5x a night vs 2.0x, 6.8 h asleep vs 7.1 h

evidence.label: Heart rate variability
evidence.text: Heart rate variability 26% lower than usual (recovery down)

evidence.label: Treatment calendar
evidence.text: Day 5 of cycle 4 (IV chemo every 21 days). The calendar alone predicts 10% risk of a rough patch this week.

recommendations.action: Call today. Ask how they feel, about fever, fluids and anything new. If anything is off, have them call their care team now.
recommendations.why: Their wearable pattern matches the days before an ER visit or hospital stay. The coach does not diagnose; the care team decides.

recommendations.action: Check in this week: ask about energy and what got in the way of moving. Offer a lighter activity goal.
recommendations.why: Movement has dropped well below their usual.

recommendations.action: Move the next coaching call earlier and plan around the expected low point.
recommendations.why: The forecast covers the next 7 days.

demo.note: Hidden from the coach view: what actually happened in the 14 days after the forecast.

definition.rough_day: daily feeling <= 2, OR weekly fatigue >= 3, OR ER visit / hospital admission / treatment paused
definition.rough_patch: a rough day followed by another within 3 days, or any clinical event; onset = first patch day after 7 quiet days
definition.forecast: each evening, P(rough patch onset in the next 7 days); days already inside a patch are not scored
definition.early_warning: an alert counts only if it fires 2+ days before onset
definition.inputs: wearable signals vs personal baseline, wear time, known treatment schedule. No self-reports, no events.
definition.split: by patient: 60% train, 15% validation (thresholds), 25% test (all numbers below)
definition.alert_budget: thresholds put 12% of quiet validation days on alert, same budget for every method

urgent.definition: P(ER visit or hospital admission in the next 7 days); urgent when in the top 3% of validation days. Separate flag; does not change the rough-patch status.
